`get_structure()` computes bonds on the full all-altloc atom array and *then* applies the altloc filter (`altloc="occupancy"`).     for k in range(next_connect_indices.shape[0]):
```python
        bonds.append((curr_connect_indices[j], next_connect_indices[k], BondType.SINGLE))
```
